# Kevxo

Kevxo is a free, private social media image resizer and 2026 image-size reference.

## Primary tool
- https://kevxo.com/ — Upload one image, choose platform presets, adjust crop and safe zones, then export PNG, JPG, WebP or a batch ZIP.

## Platform guides
- Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, Snapchat, WhatsApp, Discord, Twitch and Bluesky image sizes.

## Privacy
Image processing happens locally in the browser. Source images are not uploaded to Kevxo servers.
